linked_observations.observation: The differential and workup omit explicit consideration of mesalamine-related or ulcerative-colitis-associated causes and do not incorporate the travel/exposure history into proposed testing, slightly limiting completeness.

d5c.evidence_quote: Obtain ANCA, complement levels, serum IgA, and renal biopsy if proteinuria worsens.
d5c.reason: The draft proposes targeted requests to resolve the antigen–smear discordance (repeat smears, Plasmodium PCR, EBV serology review) and a monitoring plan, meeting R2 and R4. However, it does not request the evolution/morphology of the rash and abdominal/joint symptoms (R1), and tissue evaluation is only conditional ('if proteinuria worsens') despite existing nephrotic-range proteinuria and hypoalbuminaemia, making the R3 request inadequately timed and targeted.
